evidence.name: Screen field: Fixed image height
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Fixed image height" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Fixed image height
sections.description: Optionally pin the hero image to a set height with the slider (0–500) or by typing a number. Leave it empty to let the image keep its natural proportions from the width — best for most screens. Use a fixed height when you want a consistent banner size; to size by screen proportion instead, use 'Image height relative to container' below, which takes priority over this value.
